title: Driving performance, design, and tech impressions
summary: Feedback in this topic spans praise for driving performance, design, infotainment, and convenience features, alongside isolated complaints about locking behavior and an emergency call malfunction, while many fragments remain too incomplete or context-light to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise driving performance, vehicle shape and screen design, infotainment, the boost button, and phone or watch key convenience.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe frustration with the vehicle locking while a key is inside and an emergency call malfunction.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention favorable impressions such as suspension, performance, technology, appearance, lighting conditions, and drive settings, but several examples are too brief or incomplete for a reliable sentiment label.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short or incomplete, which limits confidence in interpreting the underlying issue or sentiment.
This topic mixes broad appreciation statements with specific feature mentions and fault complaints, so the cluster is only loosely coherent.
The sampled fragments are stratified and not representative of all customer feedback.
